entities.span: A signed in user clicks a search result through to the real posting, then marks that they applied, and the app writes one `application` row holding a full copy of the listing. Those rows are listed back on `/applications`, where they can be removed through a confirmation step.
Nothing is auto filled and nothing is submitted on anyone's behalf.
The apply write must not re-render `/search`
rejected_spans: because that would re-run the Adzuna search and spend one of the 25 weekly calls

entities.span: Adzuna's attribution obligation is per displayed advert, so it follows the listing onto `/applications`.

entities.span: The hardest part is not the write. It is that three separate mechanisms can each re-render `/search` without anyone meaning to, and two of them are invisible in review.
